# Goal
Round 59, kama. Axes: operability and calibration; calibration=7 is lowest assigned. L1 holds the planner seat. One v2 wave, 64 leaves, advisory only. Frozen claims/controls: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-59/controls/freeze.txt (freeze base 8f7f58cd; control commit 5d957d24). Current measured commits: C1 counter/checker pass at aca8d0067ea25627c5015c2193c843965148bc8e; C2 measured at 2c7443abb8d6edb8a5b0f91dfee9f81b824f6d35, fleet ref was 58cffd1f42723048bcfe48eb0bc2f346caa9b77f. C1 command: python3 tools/round59-c1-counter.py --repo <lane> --tip aca8d0067ea25627c5015c2193c843965148bc8e --work <scratch> ; C2 command: python3 tools/round59-c2-counter.py --repo <lane> --tip 2c7443abb8d6edb8a5b0f91dfee9f81b824f6d35 --fleet-ref HEAD. Treat frozen conditions as exact; never alter target, counters, kill rules, or fixtures after seeing results. Current fleet HEAD is /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin at 3f3dd97345ef1aedfdaec818c9e58675d4f41e3f; no kama r58 closure row exists; latest committed kama closure is r57 rejected-honest-stop. External S517/S518 spot-check is not yet recorded: do not claim discernment progress.

## Write and evidence bounds
Lane tree /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin is READ-ONLY except your own unique output /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-59/w1/out/<SeatName>/; no source edits, no commits/push, no sibling lanes or fleet edits. /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin is read-only; /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow is strictly read-only and never run campaign tools. Each Report trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. All scratch under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kama-r59/<SeatName>/; mkdir it, set TMPDIR explicitly, trap/finally remove it before yield; never use /tmp. Fixture Git commands must use explicit git -C "$D", verify top-level equals D before committing, and never run a throwaway identity outside D. Leaf only; never call task/spawn.

## Tooling
Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; installs allowed through uv/npx/official binary, pacman paused. Record any install/version/channel/reason. Use host role routing; never pass model aliases. Every verdict names attacked claim/clause and exact commands/output/exit; unrun is not passed. Seat work is a falsification, not the judge.
